privacy.faqBody: Your StudentVUE credentials pass through the protected backend only to sign in to the district service. Passwords are not stored or logged.

privacyParagraphs: GradeViewer uses your StudentVUE username and password only to request your own district information. Your password is not stored or logged.

The backend keeps district session cookies in memory for up to eight hours or until you log out. Grades and other school records are displayed in your browser and are not intentionally saved to a GradeViewer database.
Remember me stores only your username in your browser for up to seven days. It never stores your password.
We do not sell personal data, show targeted ads, or use student records for profiling. For privacy questions or removal requests, use the contact emails in the site footer.
